description:
This file defines the NormalForm class within the Goteo
amespace, implementing form rendering and element management, including dynamic child element creation and unique ID generation.

classes.name: NormalForm
classes.description: A class for creating and rendering HTML forms with dynamic child element management, supporting various input types and unique ID generation.

methods.name: uniqId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string with a given prefix.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Creates form element objects from an array of element definitions, handling different types and nested structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a NormalForm instance, setting properties and generating child elements.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to create and render a form instance.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the form using a view template.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the rendered form as a string, avoiding exceptions.
